name: Withdraw from the Vault
summary: Redeem raUSDC shares back into USDC — instant, non-custodial, any time.
when_to_use: The agent needs its capital back to spend and wants to convert its yield-bearing raUSDC position to USDC. Withdrawable on demand; only the position owner can withdraw.

inputs.name: shares
inputs.description: raUSDC shares to redeem (or 'max' for all)

sdk.code:
const pos = await vault.position(account.address);
await vault.withdraw(pos.shares); // or a partial share amount

risk: Non-custodial: only the position owner can withdraw. A 0.1% fee applies only when a withdrawal dips into the vault's liquid reserve.
